result.text: My cousin Jory's crew is still inside the Colossus, sealed in where the squatters haven't found a way through. They'd kept a quiet channel open. That's how I know the yard's held, and roughly by how many.
No
Captain, that's a road gun up, built by a wreck on a cradle. It'll hold longer than a checkpoint. Keep the approaches clear while Vale's fitters finish
Mara says you're the company that found out who was selling Wayline's schedules
We were
Then you'll understand why I'm careful what I say in front of Wayline's people.
We're not Wayline's people. We took their contract. Now we'd be taking yours

We'll see. You've read the survey, so you've seen the valley. Here's the rest. Three cycles back, two fleets fought it out in low orbit over Asharu. A Colossus and a few of her escorts came down here. We were the first crew in. The claim's ours
Three cycles is a long time on one wreck

It's a colossus. You don't strip one in a season. That fight dropped hulls from here to the southern flats, so every crew on Asharu had its own pickings, and nobody bothered with us. Then word got round we'd found something
Got round how?

When we opened the hold, I put in a fuel order with Wayline. Enough to lift something heavy off-world, and a camp like ours never needs that much. A few weeks later, Dace Harlan's crew came in shooting at shift change.
That's about when Whalen's schedules were being sold

You'd know better than I would. Or it was me talking too loud in a Jangala bar. I can't prove either. We got most of our people out, and now the Roaches are stripping our yard and telling anyone who'll listen it was abandoned
Most of your people
This is hegemony space. Is anyone else going to take an interest?

Our permit's on file at Jangala. The Hegemony doesn't send a patrol over two salvage crews squabbling in a ditch. It'd come quick enough if somebody gave it a reason. So we settle this ourselves, and quietly.
Then tell me where it ends. We're not going into your Colossus, and we're not chasing this outfit across Asharu
Good. I don't want you in her, and Jory's people will keep out of your way. You take the receiving store and the workshop. My militia follow you in and hold them. Then the service cradle
What's on the cradle?

A shepherd. Another hull off that fight. Broke her back coming down. We hauled her in to cut up. Her reactor and drone bay are the best scrap in this yard outside the Colossus, and I had a buyer asking after that bay before any of this. Jory says they've had her panels off for a week

I want to know what they've taken. Two of my techs on her with your rifles round them long enough to find out. Cover them from her south side. Harlan's lot come and go along the South Hall road. That's where they'll come back
South Hall checkpoint's taking fire. They're Day Hand's captain, but they're my hire. Give them a hand if you can
South Hall checkpoint's running. Can't say I blame them for what I'm paying. Cover them back to the inner line
South Hall checkpoint's gone. So much for proper guards. Watch for anyone coming back and keep that approach covered
The south hall hands have made the inner line. They're staying put at least. Help them hold it
Quarry checkpoint has contact. There's only three of them out there, Captain. Support them if you can
Quarry checkpoints falling back. Keep the crossing covered for them
The quarry checkpoint's gone. Keep the inner line covered. There may still be people coming in
The quarry hands are in on the inner line with my militia. Keep that ground covered
The new gun's covering the inner line. Keep the fitters working, Captain. We've bought them some room
That party on the South Hall Road has broken off at your screen. Keep watching the entry
They've broken off at your Quarry Road screen. Don't leave the entry open
There's a gun at the pump bend now. Keep that position covered while you move through the narrows. The haulers will need this road behind you
The position's ready. Keep the narrows covered and clear the eastern yard for her drive test. Give her room to leave
She's in the eastern yard. Your crew are spooling her drives, and Teo's talking them through it. Stay with her, Captain. Keep the approach clear
She's clear of the basin. Registry's yours, Captain. We hauled her in to cut her up. Look at her now
Abort the departure. Pull back, Captain. I'll get Morrow recovered. The deal stands. We'll have to try the road again
There's not enough of your company left to cover her. Break off. I'll get her recovered. The deal stands
Morrow's out of builders. We can't finish the road with this wing. Break off. We'll recover her and fit another
Watch the south haul approach while the builders work at the bend, Captain
Keep someone on the quarry road while you clear the narrows. That's where the new crew came down
Don't leave the pump road open behind you, Captain. We still need that position
Hold the last approach. Morrow needs that yard clear until she's away
My haulers are loaded and going nowhere. The roaches have dug in on the outer road, and two nights ago, another cruise boat came down at the quarry
So they're waiting for your shipment to move?
They're waiting for it to move without you beside it. I need the road open to the eastern yard. With positions along it, my militia can hold after you've gone
Positions built by what?
By morrow. Teo and the fitters have her lift working. She'll hover. She can crawl the road behind you and put her builders down wherever you've cleared
That's a bigger job than the yard. What does it pay?
A share when the shipment sells
When it sells? To a buyer we don't know, for cargo you won't describe, out past a crew that's already shown it'll kill for it
You've had every credit I owed you on time. Wayline haven't, so you can guess who I paid first
We have, and I'd like it to stay that way. Our payroll doesn't wait on your buyer
Then what do you want?
Morrow
She's the best thing in this yard that isn't in the Colossus. Her bay was meant to carry this camp through the season, and now she flies, she's worth three times that
Who are you going to sell her to?
That's my business
Whoever buys a flying shepherd has to register her at a Hegemony port. Somebody asks where she came from. Then somebody asks what else came down in this valley
Is that a threat?
It's a reason. We've no interest in telling anyone anything. A mercenary company coming out of a wreck field with a recovered hull is nobody's news. It's how we got our first ship
Take her for the job then. Bring her back when the road's done, and I'll pay you out of the shipment on top
That's the same promise with a ship attached
Then hear mine. You get the hull and nothing else. Every spare we've already pulled off her stays here. The guns she builds stay here. Not a credit for the road and not a bolt out of the Colossus
Agreed.
And she's not yours until the road's handed to my militia and she's clear of this basin. You don't lift while my people are still walking into position
They'll have cover all the way up. We hand over each position before we move on. Who's flying her?
Your own people. Nobody from Basin goes with her. Not Teo, not anyone
I wasn't going to ask
Good. Theo will walk your crew through her before the drive test. Then he comes home
We'll put a crew across from Second Wind. Both ships will be running thin until we can hire. Send the terms, and I'll put it to the captain
I'll send them. Get her out in one piece, Castle. I've watched enough ships come down in this valley

Morrow's holding a hover. Bring her along the road to the eastern yard. Clear the pump bend and use build Vulcan turret on ground her builders can reach, then do the same at the narrows. Cover the work and wait for my militia to take over. Keep the company with her for the drive test. If the drives give out, break off and we'll recover her. The deal stands either way.
Your company can't cover the work any longer. Break off. We'll pick up from whatever's finished
No builders left to finish the gun. Break off, Captain. The delivery and the power work will keep

Waylines finally drop the distribution rig on the receiving apron. My fitters take it to the workshop, bring the pump station back, and put shore power into the yard. You keep them breathing while they do it. Then you're done
And the roads?
Checkpoints on the south hall and the quarry road, manned by day hands from the camps down the valley. My own militia hold the inner line
Day hands
Armed, paid, and a third of what you cost
Harlan's crew took this yard off your own people. They'll know what a checkpoint is worth
Harlan's past the quarry. Jory's watched for three days and they haven't come near
Your text said Harlan's crew were trying to wake Morrow's Bay. Did anyone ask why?

Teo thinks her builders could put guns up round the yard. Maybe they could. That bay's the most saleable thing I own outside the Colossus, and every hour those drones work is wear on it. I'm not burning it on guns I don't need
Your yard. Captain, we cover the rig and the pump, and when the lights come on, we lift
Keep fire off my sitters. And if those checkpoints call for help, they're on my payroll. Cover them back to the inner line
Captain, last job on Asharu. Get the rig to the workshop, then cover Vale's fitters at the pump. When the lights come on, we lift.
The rig's on the apron, Captain. Stay with it along the workshop road. I paid for every bolt of it
Rig's at the workshop. Now clear the pump station for my fitters. They need to reconnect shore power
They're on the pump connection. Keep that ground covered until they're done
Shore power's on, and Teo says Morrow's bay is answering. Damn the buyer. Select Build Vulcan Turret and put a road gun on clear ground within reach of her bay
Workshop's running and Morrow's Bay is drawing steady. That's the job done, Captain. I'll settle your fee
We've lost the repair crew. Pull back, Captain. What they finished stays finished. I'll have to find other hands
The rig's gone. We can't do this without it. Pull the company back, Captain
That's not a probe. Harlan's coming for the yard. Castle, I know you were about to lift. Stay. Keep them off my fitters and watch any drones that are out. They won't stand up to gunfire
You're down, Captain. Receiving store first, then the workshop. My militia are behind you. Leave the Colossus to us
Receiving stores secure. Workshop next, Captain. Watch the gaps between those salvage stacks
Workshop's ours. The cradle's just past it. Clear the ground on Morrow's south side for my techs and keep it clear
There's the Shepherd. Morrow by her hull plate. Panels open all down her flank. Somebody's been busy. Let's see what's left in her
Captain, keep an eye on the South Hall Road. It's their way back in. Don't pull cover off the techs to chase them
South side's clear. My techs are crossing now. Stay close enough to cover them while they work
Hostiles at the cradle. The techs have stopped work. Clear them some room, Captain
They're done. Her bay's still in her, and the squatters had cable run into it. They weren't cutting her up, Captain. They were trying to wake her. Your fee's released
We've lost the inspection party, Captain. Pull back. Nothing more gets done here without another crew.
Castle something for when the company's ready and not before. One of our accounts on Asharu has a problem
Wayline has accounts on Asharu now?
A few. We haul supplies, fuel, and heavy machinery out to the salvage crews there. A little under what the other outfits on Jangala charge. It's how you win customers back after a year like ours
And this one?
Basin Reclamation. A salvage crew working a wreck field in the northern canyons. Tamsin Vale runs it. She came to us because we were cheapest, and she counts every credit like it's her last
What's gone wrong?
Another salvage crew walked in with guns and took her yard. Her account's gone quiet, and there's a load of heavy machinery she's already paid for sitting in our shed with nowhere to deliver it
So this is Wayline's problem as much as hers
At our rates, I can't afford to lose a paying customer. She'd like her yard back. You'd like to be paid. I don't see anyone losing
Is she a friend of yours?
She's a customer, not a happy one. She'll tell you why herself if she decides she likes you. The survey's attached. I told her you were good and quiet
Vale, while we're on the way down, what did you find in that hold?
Salvage mine
My people are about to be shot at over it. I'd like to know what for

You're being shot at over my yard, my stores, and my workshop, and you're paid for every bit of it. Ask Mara whether I settle. The last time that hold went on anybody's paperwork, I got this. I won't do it twice with people Wayline sent me.

The rig's still at the workshop, but the pump connection isn't finished. I've found another repair party. Cover them while they get shore power in. Then we try Morrow's Bay for that road gun. Same contract. I've found more day hands for the checkpoints, for whatever that's worth. Help them back to the inner line if they have to come in

The rig's at the workshop and shore power's holding, so we pick up from there. Another repair party's ready. Get that road gun out of Morrow's Bay and keep the fitters covered. Same contract. I've found more day hands for the checkpoints, for whatever that's worth. Help them back to the inner line if they have to come in

We still have a deal, Castle. Teo needs time on her drives before we try again. I'll see to it, and I'll send fresh holders. Clear the pump bend and the narrows, cover the building, then hand the positions over. Stay with her through the drive test. When the road's ours and she's clear of the basin, she's yours
Payments received? Why would a salvage crew want a wrecked drone tender awake?
Same reason anyone wants builders on a yard they mean to keep, I'd guess. Doesn't matter now. The bay's still in her, and she's still mine
They won't have gone far

Past the quarry, Jory says, and still going. I've got my yard back and no power to work it. The heavy machinery to fix that is still in Wayline's shed, and they stripped the pump station. Mara can deliver now there's a yard to deliver to. One more contract. Cover my fitters while we get the lights on.
One more?
After that, I've got guards coming for the roads. Nothing personal, Castle. You're good, and you're not cheap
We'll get the company ready. Keep your fitters together until we're there to cover them.
You lost people at that cradle. We'll put ours in order before we take another crew out there
Do. The rig will be on the receiving apron. Come to me when you're ready
Captain, did you see how fast those builders put that gun up? Off a wreck we found in pieces
I saw. Teo had her bay talking before the lights were steady. A shepherd with a working bay is worth three of her in pieces, so don't look at her like that, Castle. Your fee's sent.
And your checkpoints?

Paid off. Most of them have gone home, and I can't say I blame them. Harland's back on the outer road, and Jory says he's had company since. Finish up with your people, then come and see me. Seems I'm not done with you after all
We'll need time before we take on anything else. We've people to account for
So do I. Take it. The outer road's still shut, and I won't talk about that over the radio. Come and see me when you can
Registry confirms it, Captain. Morrow's ours. She's flying on a skeleton crew off Second Wind, and Second Wind's not much better off. We'll need to hire before we ask much of either of them
Have your crew check her drone bay filters first. Basin dust gets into everything
Any chance of hands from the camp?
Try the port at Jangala. Nobody in this valley's leaving it for you
Jory's crew can walk out of the Colossus tonight. Safe passage, Castle
I know what it cost your people to get her out. I'll leave you to them. Safe passage, Castle
I'd better go. There are families waiting on a call from me, and some of them are mine. Look after her, Castle
